credential_manager.text: Keeps the device key in Windows Credential Manager and stores account cookies in per-account credential entries. The account file remains encrypted and can unlock automatically on this Windows user profile; clearing or losing the credentials can make the store unavailable.

multi_instance.text: Releases Roblox's singleton mutex so RM can launch more than one RobloxPlayerBeta.exe process. This interacts with Hyperion anti-cheat behavior and may carry account or ban risk.

kill_background_roblox.text: Periodically finds RobloxPlayerBeta.exe processes started with --launch-to-tray and attempts to close them. RM also runs this cleanup before launches; normal game clients are not targeted.

auto_arrange_windows.text: After a launch burst, waits for the clients to appear and arranges attributed Roblox windows using the selected monitor target, layout mode, and padding.

target_display.text: Selects the primary monitor, a specific detected monitor, or all detected monitors as the target for window arrangement.

grid_layout.text: Selects automatic square-like tiling, a fixed column count, a fixed row count, an explicit column-by-row grid, one row, or one column.

layout_columns.text: Sets the column count for a custom grid. The value is limited to 1-12; the number of rows is configured in the same control.

layout_rows.text: Sets the fixed row count used when the layout mode is Fixed Rows. The value is limited to 1-12; the number of columns is calculated to fit the windows.

layout_dimensions.text: Sets the column count used by Fixed Columns. The value is limited to 1-12; the number of rows is calculated to fit the windows.

window_padding.text: Sets the spacing, in pixels, between tiled windows and the usable display edges and between neighboring windows. The value is limited to 0-50 px.

rename_windows.text: Changes each attributed Roblox window title to its account alias, or username when no alias is set. Titles are visible to other programs and in screenshots or streams; RM restores the original titles when renaming is disabled or the app exits.

launch_delay.text: Sets the minimum pause between successive account launches, including bulk launches. It can be 0-300 seconds and may help when Roblox rate-limits rapid launches from an IP address.

privacy_mode.text: Truncates %LOCALAPPDATA%\Roblox\LocalStorage\RobloxCookies.dat before each launch. Roblox recreates the file for later use; clearing it may reduce account association through stored browser cookies but does not guarantee isolation.

anonymize_names.text: Replaces usernames, display names, and aliases shown by RM with stable generic account labels. Renamed Roblox windows use the same generic labels, and cached avatars are blurred when displayed in the app.

utility_enabled.text: Adds the Utility tab to the top navigation. The current Utility area is a placeholder for future tools and does not provide additional functionality yet.

developer_options.text: Adds the Assets tab to the Utility area. Asset uploads create permanent public Roblox assets and are moderated under the account that uploads them.

data_folder.text: Opens RM's data folder at %APPDATA%\RM in Windows Explorer. It contains the encrypted account store, configuration, rotating logs, presets, and the asset index.

roblox_player_path.text: Optional path to RobloxPlayerBeta.exe, or to its containing folder. RM launches this executable directly; when empty, it searches installed versions under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Roblox\Versions.

encryption_password.text: Switches the account store to password mode. RM derives its wrapping key with Argon2id and asks for this password at startup; forgetting it prevents the encrypted store from being unlocked. Changing it rewraps the store's data key.
